title: Archivooor
tagline: Watch and capture your favorite moments and highlights of events
description:
A platform that leverages the power of Web3 communities and composable data (live-streams) to create a community curated overview of highlights, announcements or any of their favorite moments.

This enables
- A novel way to increase online community participation and engagement
- Allow people to start capturing their highlights while live streams are still running
- Much faster processing of videos and content 
- Potential for new curation algorithms and reward mechanisms between curators, creators, speakers and event organizers
how_its_made:
The platform uses Livepeer as one of the fundamentals building blocks to fetch the live-streams and recorded content. The full streams are used to allow people to create their clips. Submitting a clip triggers a Github Action which ensures processing happens transparently. Since this is an asynchronous process the creator is notified whenever the video is ready using Push protocol. Anyone who subscribed to the channel will also get an update whenever a new video is available.

All videos and metadata are stored on IPFS to ensure anyone can watch without any platform or risks of censorship.
